stem.text: The time taken for an object to fall from rest through a certain distance on Mars is $T_\text{M}$. The time taken for the same object to fall from rest through the same distance on Earth is $T_\text{E}$. The acceleration of free fall on Mars is $3.71\,\text{m s}^{-2}$.
Assume that air resistance is negligible on both Earth and Mars.
